headline: GOLD SLIPS TO $4,019 AS FED DECEMBER HIKE ODDS HIT 73% — Silver Rebounds 1.6% to $56.73; Oil Tops $90 on Day-9 US-Iran Air War
snippet: Spot gold fell 0.40% to $4,019 Monday as escalating U.S.-Iran strikes kept Brent crude above $90, driving inflation expectations and December Fed rate-hike probability on CME FedWatch to 73%. Silver outperformed with a 1.62% gain to $56.73 — a divergence analysts attribute to silver's lower oil-inflation sensitivity relative to gold as Dallas Fed's Logan became the first Warsh-era official to publicly call for a rate hike.

headline: EASTPORT CRITICAL METALS DRILLS FIVE 100m+ COPPER ZONES AT MATSITAMA NAK-MAIN — Higher-Grade Core 0.5%–1.5%+ Cu; Resource Upgrade Next (TSXV: EVI)
snippet: Phase One infill drilling at the Nakalakwana deposit confirmed continuous copper mineralisation across five holes each exceeding 100 metres, with internal zones reaching 0.5% to greater than 1.5% Cu. Results validate the historical resource at Eastport's Matsitama Copper Project in Botswana and set the stage for an updated NI 43-101 mineral resource estimate.

headline: MACQUARIE: LME COPPER AT 8-YEAR HIGH WITH 262,000-TONNE SURPLUS — Contrarian Call Challenges UBS Deficit Consensus at $6.29/lb
snippet: Macquarie Strategy warns the copper rally is running well ahead of physical fundamentals: LME inventories sit at eight-year highs, Comex stockpiles are at records, and an estimated 550,000 additional tonnes sits off-exchange in the U.S. The bank projects a 262,000-tonne 2026 surplus and $11,000/tonne floor by Q3 2027 — directly contradicting UBS's 520,000-tonne deficit call.

headline: ORESTONE MINING TRACES 4.45 g/t GOLD OVER 21m AT TOM EAST ZONE — 200×200m Soil Grid Launched in Salta Province, Argentina (TSXV: ORS)
snippet: Follow-up exploration at the Tom East zone of Orestone's 23 sq.km Francisca Gold-Silver Project in Salta Province, Argentina returned 4.45 g/t gold over 21 metres in Trench 6B from a chalcedonic quartz stockwork. A detailed 200×200m soil-sampling grid has been launched to define high-priority drill targets at the property alongside the adjacent Kelly gold zone.

headline: GOLD:SILVER RATIO HITS 70:1 AS RATE-HIKE FEARS HIT INDUSTRIAL DEMAND — JPMorgan $81 Base Case Implies 50:1 Normalization
snippet: The gold-to-silver ratio reached 70:1 — near the top of its two-year range — as Fed rate-hike fears weighed on silver's industrial demand outlook, which accounts for roughly 58% of total consumption. JPMorgan's $81 base-case target for silver in 2026 implies a ratio closer to 50:1 at current gold prices, suggesting significant mean-reversion potential if the macro narrative shifts.

headline: GOLD PRICE OUTLOOK JULY 2026: 'THE PRICE FELL. THE CASE IS INTACT.' — Central Bank Buying, Fiscal Deterioration Unchanged
snippet: GoldSilver.com walks through the July correction argument by argument: central banks are still buying at record pace, the U.S. fiscal deficit hit $316B in a single month, and the oil-driven inflation overlay is a cyclical headwind on a secular monetary trend. The piece identifies which bearish argument deserves the most weight and why the structural long-gold thesis remains intact.

headline: PRECIOUS METALS ACCUMULATE AS IRAN ATTACKS DRIVE OIL, STOCKS FALTER — GoldSeek Tracks Physical Buying Into the Rate-Hike Selloff
snippet: GoldSeek's weekly market view documents significant accumulation of physical gold and silver by longer-term buyers as equity markets faltered on higher energy prices and geopolitical risk. The analysis frames the current Iran-driven oil shock and Fed rate-hike fears as a supply-side inflation event — historically supportive of precious metals over a 6–18 month horizon once the initial headwind passes.

headline: DRYDEN GOLD (TSXV: DRY) GETS DRILL PERMIT FOR 93 g/t SURFACE GOLD DISCOVERY — Mud Lake and Wamsley Targets Cleared for August Drill in Ontario
snippet: Dryden Gold received exploration permits for the Mud Lake discovery target in Northwestern Ontario, where surface samples from a high-grade shear zone returned up to 93 g/t gold — one of the stronger surface grabs reported in the region in recent years. One drill rig is expected to mobilize to Mud Lake in August 2026, with the permit also covering the adjacent Wamsley target.

headline: GOLD SUMMER DOLDRUMS 2026: AUGUST HISTORICALLY WEAK — Seasonal Data Points to September as Key Inflection Window
snippet: GoldSeek's seasonal analysis shows gold typically faces headwinds in July–August before a statistically significant autumn rally window opens each September. With gold down roughly 10% from its February 2026 peak and real rates elevated on oil-inflation fears, the historical setup for a late-Q3 recovery is intact — though the Iran-oil overlay adds unusual macro noise to the normal seasonal pattern.
